draft.briefing: Hey, you're in Thodupuzha! It's the largest town in Idukki, and people call it the district's real capital because the official one, Painavu, stayed a sleepy village. It's also your gateway to Munnar, Thekkady and Peermade.
draft.hungryLine: Thodupuzha has lots of restaurants doing tasty meat and fish dishes. For a toddy shop meal, there's a well-known one on Manakkad road.

moodReplies.show-me-around: Start at the Sree Krishna Swami Temple in the heart of town, then walk to the Kanjiramattam Sree Mahadeva Temple on the river.
moodReplies.somewhere-to-chill: Sit by the Thodupuzha River near the Kanjiramattam temple and let the afternoon slide by.
moodReplies.surprise-me: Krishna at the town temple is shown as Navaneetha Krishna, holding butter in his right palm.

spots.name: Sree Krishna Swami Temple, Thodupuzha
spots.detail: 4 min walk · Krishna holding butter, right in town

spots.name: Kanjiramattam Sree Mahadeva Temple
spots.detail: 23 min walk · Ancient Shiva temple on the river

legends.title: Parasurama's temple
legends.body: It is believed this is one of Kerala's 108 Shiva temples, installed by the sage Parasurama. Shiva is shown meditating under a Kalpavriksha with Parvati.

legends.title: Two mutts, one temple
legends.body: By tradition, the Aramallur Kavanattu Mana holds the tantric rights here. Daily poojas are run by two mutts, Padinjare mutt and Thuruthel mutt.

tips.title: Use it as a base.
tips.body: Thodupuzha is the gateway to the High Range, including Munnar, Thekkady and Peermade.

tips.title: Hanging bridges are gone.
tips.body: The hanging bridges on the way to Moolamattam were dismantled after the 2018 flood.

story.title: Karikkode, the old capital
story.body: Karikkode was the capital of the Vadakkumkoor principality. When Travancore annexed it, Diwan Ramayyan's forces destroyed it.

story.title: A new headquarters
story.body: Maharaja Anizham Thirunal Marthanda Varma sent Elasamprathi Narayana Varma to run the area. Edavathuruth, among rocky hillocks, became the new taluk headquarters.

story.title: A village church
story.body: St. Mary's Catholic Church was built in nearby Kalayanthani, a village known as the 'Land of Art'.

story.title: The flood
story.body: The great flood took its toll, and the hanging bridges towards Moolamattam were dismantled.

story.title: Idukki's busiest town
story.body: Thodupuzha is the largest town and main commercial centre in Idukki district.

food.name: Mundekkallu shap
food.detail: Toddy shop on Manakkad road, with tasty food and fresh kallu
